bomb_blast.name: Bomb
bomb_blast.description: A fused ball of powder, lit where you stand.
bomb_blast.cast_message: You light the fuse and step back. The bomb goes off with a crack and a cloud of grit.

fire_arrow.name: Arrow
fire_arrow.description: Loose an arrow at one enemy. It costs a rupee.
fire_arrow.cast_message: You draw the bow and loose an arrow.

throw_whirlwing.name: Whirlwing
throw_whirlwing.description: Throw the whirlwing: it stuns what it strikes and comes back.
throw_whirlwing.cast_message: You throw the whirlwing, and it spins out and comes back to your hand.
throw_whirlwing.hit_message: The whirlwing cracks against {target_name} for {value} damage!

spit_big.name: Spit Rock
spit_big.description: A rock the size of a fist, spat across the room.
spit_big.cast_message: {caster_name} gulps and spits a rock at you.

spit_stone.name: Spit Stone
spit_stone.description: A stone spat across the room.
spit_stone.cast_message: {caster_name} gulps and spits a stone at you.

hurl_whirlwing.name: Hurl
hurl_whirlwing.cast_message: {caster_name} hurls a curved stick at you.
hurl_whirlwing.hit_message: The stick cracks against {target_name} for {value} damage!

aquilor_flame.name: Drake Flame
aquilor_flame.cast_message: {caster_name} spits a ball of fire at you.
aquilor_flame.hit_message: The fire washes over {target_name} for {value} damage!

hand_grab.name: Grasp
hand_grab.description: A cold hand reaches out of the wall and carries you off.
hand_grab.cast_message: {caster_name} closes on you out of the wall.

teleport.message: The hand drags you through the wall and lets go at the door you came in by.

throw_stormwing.name: Stormwing
throw_stormwing.description: Throw the stormwing: it hits hard, stuns for a long while and comes back.
throw_stormwing.cast_message: You throw the stormwing, and it howls out and comes back.
throw_stormwing.hit_message: The stormwing smashes into {target_name} for {value} damage!

candle_flame.name: Candle
candle_flame.description: A candle's flame: it lights the room you stand in until you leave it, and burns what is there.
candle_flame.cast_message: You touch the wick to a spark, and a small flame stands up and widens into a room of light.

rod_bolt.name: Wyrmrod
rod_bolt.description: Point the wyrmrod: a bolt of cold fire flies from it.
rod_bolt.cast_message: You point the wyrmrod and a bolt of cold fire leaps from its tip.

hydra_flame.name: Hydra Flame
hydra_flame.description: A ball of fire from a hydra's head.
hydra_flame.cast_message: {caster_name} rears back and spits a ball of fire.
hydra_flame.hit_message: The fire washes over {target_name} for {value} damage!

hexer_bolt.name: Hexer Bolt
hexer_bolt.description: A bolt of hex, thrown in a flash.
hexer_bolt.cast_message: {caster_name} flings a bolt of blue light.

hexer_bolt_strong.name: Hexer Bolt
hexer_bolt_strong.description: A hard bolt of hex, thrown in a flash.
hexer_bolt_strong.cast_message: {caster_name} flings a bolt of white light.

claw_flame.name: Claw Flame
claw_flame.description: Fire from a great crab's eye.
claw_flame.cast_message: {caster_name}'s eye flares and spits a ball of fire.
claw_flame.hit_message: The fire washes over {target_name} for {value} damage!

devour_shield.name: Devour
devour_shield.description: The shield-eater wraps round you and swallows what you carry on your arm.
devour_shield.cast_message: {caster_name} drops over you like a wet cloth.

effects.message: The shield-eater folds round your arm, and when it lets go the magical shield is gone.

rod_flame.name: Wyrmflame
rod_flame.description: Point the wyrmrod with the tome open: a ball of true fire flies from it.
rod_flame.cast_message: You point the wyrmrod, and the tome's page flares, and the bolt that leaves it is orange.
rod_flame.requires_message: You need the wyrmrod and the tome together.
